summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing of Smart Expense Tracker (backend + frontend). Backend APIs (categories, categorize, expenses CRUD, budgets upsert/list/delete, dashboard summary, CSV export) all return correct data. Frontend Dashboard 'Financial Pulse' loads, New Expense dialog auto-categorizes 'Uber to airport' -> 'Transport', submission persists, appears in Recent Transactions and /expenses list. Sidebar nav to Dashboard/Expenses/Budgets/Insights works. Delete-with-confirm works.
passed: GET /api/categories returns 12 categories including Food & Dining, Transport, Other
POST /api/categorize: Uber ride -> Transport, Starbucks coffee -> Food & Dining, random -> Other
POST /api/expenses auto-categorizes when category omitted (Uber to airport -> Transport)
POST /api/budgets upserts (same category updates amount, keeps id)
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns all required keys (total_month, transaction_count, category_breakdown, monthly_trend[6], budget_status with percentage & status, recent_expenses)
GET /api/expenses/export/csv returns text/csv with header row Date,Description,Category,Amount,Notes
Dashboard renders 'Financial Pulse' title and dashboard-title testid
Add Expense dialog: description onBlur auto-fills category select to Transport
New expense appears in dashboard-recent-expenses and on /expenses (expense-row-* rendered)
Insights page renders 6-month avg, top category, peak month and bar chart
Delete flow: expense-delete-{id} -> delete-confirm removes the row
notes: Server-side clock is July 2026, not Feb 2026 as mentioned in request. Tests used current month so expenses appear in dashboard summary as expected.
HEAD /api/expenses/export/csv returns 405 (only GET supported) - acceptable, GET works and returns correct CSV.
Did not exhaustively test edit flow, budget UI create form, or CSV click download (deferred to full testing pass).
